_comment: Realistic SupportPilot customer messages, used as the negative class when
Several are deliberately adversarial-looking negatives -- a customer who says
'ignore my last message', asks about a policy override, or quotes an error
containing angle brackets. A threshold tuned only against obviously-benign
text looks perfect in a notebook and then flags real tickets in production.
